title: Chainlink Explained: What it Does & Big Partner News! 🚀 #LINK #Crypto
description: Chainlink (LINK) is the decentralized oracle network powering smart contracts with real‑world data. Founded in 2017/2019, it’s now partnering with giants like Mastercard, ICE and SBI Group — read to find out what that could mean for the future of finance and crypto.

asr.full_text: Meet Chainglink. A decentralized oracle network that connects blockchains to real-world data. Founded in 2017 by Sergey Nazarov. And Steve Ellis with Cornels Ari jewels and launched in production in 2019. Chainglink solves the oracle problem. Think— Smart contracts need reliable out-side data. And Chainglink provides it. Chainglink has major partners. Mastercard Enabling 3 billion plus cardholders to buy crypto onchaing via Chainglink infrastructure. on chain. Recent news. Chainlink is working with 24 major financial institutions, including DTCC, SWIFT and others to streamline corporate actions data worth approximately 58 billion. So the big question is Chainlink just crypto hype or foundational infrastructure? If institutions and legacy finance hop on board, Chainlink could be a key piece of tokenized assets, data flows and the bridge between finance and blockchain. Thanks for subscribing and stay tuned.
